original.claim: The print opens in treble and bass, with one sharp and 2/4. P001 holds one quarter, so it is a pickup.
original.print_finding: System 1 shows both clefs, one sharp, and a 2 over a 4. P001 then has a quarter note over an eighth rest and closes at x 440.

independent_finding: Pickup is a flagged eighth B4 above an eighth rest, capacity 1/2 quarter; the quarter-note assertion is false. Current approved frame correctly says 1/2 and requires no repair.

original.claim: Two pages contain 57 printed bars in eleven systems: 5, 5, 5, 5, 5, 5, 6, 6, 5, 5, and 5.
original.print_finding: Full barlines that cross both staves were measured on the frozen pages. Page 1 has five systems and page 2 has six.

independent_finding: Confirmed against both full pages and system crops in Phase 1.

original.claim: No repeat dots are printed. P057 ends with a thin-thick final barline.
original.print_finding: The final pair is a thin stroke at x 1500 and a thick stroke at x 1506. No earlier barline has dots in the staff spaces.

independent_finding: Confirmed against both full pages and system crops in Phase 1.

original.claim: The upper staff stays treble and the lower staff stays bass. Opening clefs on later systems are reprints.
original.print_finding: Each system begins with a treble clef above a bass clef. No clef stands inside a bar.

independent_finding: Confirmed against both full pages and system crops in Phase 1.

original.claim: P002 through P057 each hold 2 quarters. The one-sharp signature does not change.
original.print_finding: One sharp is printed at the opening and reprinted at each later system. No new meter or signature appears.

independent_finding: Confirmed against both full pages and system crops in Phase 1.
